job.job_description:
Claude Certified Developer Junior / Trainee

Experience: 0- 6 Year

Location: Pune

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a Claude Certified Developer with 05 year of experience who is passionate about Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-powered application development. The candidate will work on building, testing, and integrating AI solutions using Anthropic Claude and related AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Develop AI-powered applications and features using Anthropic Claude.
Work with Claude APIs, prompts, and LLM-based workflows.
Create and optimize prompts for different business use cases.
Build basic RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions.
Integrate LLM capabilities with web applications and backend services.
Perform testing and evaluation of AI-generated responses.
Troubleshoot issues related to API integration and AI workflows.
Collaborate with developers and business teams to understand AI requirements.
Stay updated with Generative AI, LLM, and Agentic AI developments.

Required Skills

Claude / Anthropic API
Claude Certified Developer certification
Basic knowledge of Generative AI & LLMs
Prompt Engineering
Basic Python or JavaScript/TypeScript
REST APIs and JSON
Basic understanding of RAG and embeddings
Good problem-solving and communication skills

Good to Have

LangChain / LlamaIndex
Vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, or FAISS
OpenAI or other LLM APIs
Git/GitHub
Cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
Basic knowledge of AI Agents / Agentic AI

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience: 0–6 year

Suitable for: Freshers with relevant certification/projects and candidates with up to 2 year of experience.
